decisions.reason: The height-adjustable executive desk system carries substantial development investment, has its own web page, and is central to the announced direction of flexible workplace solutions, so management will persist with it.
A chair family close to the core offer, presented on its own page, is a visible commitment that fits the established range, and any weak early sales can be put down to ramp-up effects.
The carpet-derived floor cushions are a smaller niche item, but they are publicly presented and tie into the sustainability narrative, so management likely keeps them despite modest investment.

The soft sofa is close to core competencies in upholstery and craftsmanship, though it is only mentioned on the website, so the public commitment is weaker and dropping it is somewhat more likely than for the flagship products.
The high standing table supports the adaptable office and conference direction and is presented on its own page, so management will justify continuing it.

The rug collection is distant from the core offer and therefore riskier, but its own web page and the investment in a new category push management to attribute slow results to market entry and persist.
